simple.meaning: חֵצִי (chêtsîy) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “the half or middle.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 123 times across Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, Judges, and 7 more, beginning at Exodus 12:29. Its contexts include birth, firstborn, altar, blood, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֵצִי (H2677).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חֵצִי (chêtsîy) / H2677 is traced through Exodus 12:29, Exodus 24:6, Exodus 25:10, Exodus 25:17 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.usage: half, middle, mid(-night), midst, part, two parts.
definitions.full: H2677. chatsi חֲצִי 123 noun masculine Num 12:12 half (Late Hebrew id. ; Phoenician חצי ; on formative see Lag BN 113 ) — absolute חֲצִי 1Kin 3:25 (twice in verse) + 3t.; הַחֵ֑צִי 10:7 , compare 16:21 ; וָחֵ֔צִי Ezek 40:42 ; וָחֵצִי Dan 12:7 13 t. (usually with Pashta or Tiphcha), compare בַּחֵ֖צִי 2Sam 10:4 ; 1Chr 19:4 ; construct חֲצִי Exod 12:29 84t.; suffix חֶצְיוֺ 38:4 7 t. + Josh 8:33 וְהַחֶצְיוֺ (but article suspicious. see Ges § 127 R 3, 4); חֶצְיָהּ Nehemiah 3:38; חֶצְיֵנוּ 2Sam 18:3 ; חֶצְיָם Zech 14:8 (twice in verse) + 2t. — 1 half of anything: — blood of offering Exod 24:6 (twice in verse) (JE), beard 2Sam 10:4 , a hin Num 15:9-10 , 28:14 (P); curtain Exod 26:12 (P); week ׳ח השׁבוע Dan 9:27 etc.; ׳ח אַמָּה half a cubit Exod 26:16 ; 36:21 (P) +; especially ׳ח שׁבט half a tribe Num 32:33 ; 34:13-14 , 15 (P) +; half of people 2Sam 18:3 ; 19:41 ; 1Kin 16:21 (3 t. in verse) +, etc. so ׳ח הַמְּנֻחוֺת 1Chr 2:52 and ׳ח הַמָּנַחְתִּי 2:54 (see Be and מָנַחַת below נוח ). — On כבחצי 1Sam 14:4 see We Dr. 2 middle ׳ח הלילה Exod 12:29 (J) midnight , so Judg 16:3 (twice in verse); Ruth 3:8 ; of garments 2Sam 10:4 ; 1Chr 19:4 ; altar Exod 27:5 ; of the Mt. of Olives Zech 14:4 ; ׳ח יָמַי Psa 102:25 the midst of my days (when they are but half done), Jer 17:11 .
